'''Alee Aroval''' was a [[Data Forger|data forger]]. He wandered from system to system in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. He rarely stayed in the same port for more than a month. He acquired a stolen [[Bureau of Ships and Services/Legends|BoSS]] Interface plug, allowing him to make near-perfect alterations to [[Spacer/Legends|spacers']] permit [[Datapad/Legends|datapads]]. Some said he used to work for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] and rumor had it he swindled an important [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Clan Chief]] out of a millions [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|Credits]] before he fled.<ref name="PSG" />
